greek-fire-constantinople.description: An oared wooden warship with a bronze tube at its prow shoots a long jet of fire over the water. Sailors in tunics work at the deck, and a second burning boat sits on the right. Dark smoky sky, flames on the waves, and a rigged sail at the top. Painted in an oil-paint style, with no visible text or frame.

great-bombard-constantinople.description: A huge bronze cannon with a wide barrel lies on a stack of timber beams. Turbaned men in loose period dress haul a large grey stone ball and pull ropes beside it. Behind them stands a tall crenellated stone wall with striped towers, with smoke and small fires rising in the background and wooden palisades at the sides. The painting is edge to edge with no visible text or frame.

leonardo-armoured-car.description: An elderly bearded man in a dark robe, seen from the side, adjusts a small detail on a wooden dome-shaped contraption with a tiny cupola on top and cannon barrels protruding from its lower sides. It sits on a wooden workbench with brass dividers, gear wheels, hand tools and a sheet of paper covered in faint sketch lines. The background is dark and smoky, with no frame or border visible.

nagashino-matchlock-volleys.description: A painted scene of soldiers in conical hats and dark lamellar armour firing long matchlock guns over a wooden palisade, with white smoke and muzzle flashes. Two kneeling men in the foreground load or pour powder, and mounted riders with war banners approach in the background. There is no visible text or signature, and the painting runs to all four edges with no frame or wall. Nothing gory is visible.

puckle-gun-patented.description: A man in a grey wig and dark long coat aims a brass-and-wood revolving gun on a tall three-legged wooden tripod down a cobbled alley lined with timber-framed brick buildings, a lantern on the wall, barrels and crates around. A workbench to the right holds iron balls, a brass canister and small blocks. No text or frame is visible; the scene fills the canvas edge to edge.

first-aerial-bombing-libya.description: A pilot in a leather jacket, cap and goggles leans out of the open cockpit of a vintage biplane with fabric wings, holding a small round grenade-like bomb above a desert camp of white tents and palm trees. Smoke rises near the tents, and small figures stand among them. The painting is in an oil-paint style, full bleed, with no visible text, frame or border.

thompson-submachine-gun.description: A dark, painterly still life. An open black hard case sits on a worn wooden counter, lined with black fabric and divided into compartments. In it lies a submachine gun with a long barrel, a round drum magazine under the receiver, and wooden grips and stock. A second round drum sits in a compartment to the left. Behind is a dim room with wooden cabinets and glass display cases. No people, no visible text, no frame.

spitfire-first-flight.description: A grey-green single-engine monoplane fighter with a propeller spinning, lifting off or flying low over a grass field under a dark, stormy sky. A hangar stands at the right edge, and a group of uniformed men in overalls watch from the lower right. No visible text, frame or border.

dambusters-bouncing-bombs.description: A four-engined bomber with a glazed nose and twin-tail-fin style rear flies low over dark, moonlit water, trailing a faint spray line. A barrel-shaped drum sits skipping across the surface in the foreground, throwing up a white splash. In the background a long stone dam with two towers is lit by orange fireballs and bursts, with searchlight beams sweeping a cloudy night sky. The painting is edge to edge with no frame, border or text.

me-262-jet-fighter-combat.description: A swept-wing jet fighter in purple and grey-green camouflage with two engine pods streaks diagonally through dark clouds, a thin smoke trail rising behind it. Small bombers with multiple engines fly in a formation at the lower left. Painted in an oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

ak-47-designed.description: An oil-painting style still life of a dark workshop bench. Two rifles with wooden stocks and handguards and long curved magazines lie side by side among scattered screws, wrenches, calipers, a hammer and a bench vise. Cloth rags sit at the lower left, and the background is dark with hanging tools. No people. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.

b-52-enters-service.description: A large silver swept-wing bomber with a tall vertical tail and paired engine pods under its wings sits on a wet, reflective tarmac under a dark stormy sky. Three or four people in uniform or overalls stand and kneel beside a small cart-like machine near the front wheels. A round star-and-bar roundel is on the fuselage. Distant aircraft and vehicles are faint in the background. The image is a painterly oil style, with no visible letters or numbers.

m16-rifle-adopted.description: A painted soldier in a camouflage-covered steel helmet and olive fatigues with a harness wades through dense jungle undergrowth, holding a black rifle with a carry handle across his chest. A second soldier behind him, partly in shadow, carries a longer rifle with a wooden stock. Lush green foliage and hanging vines fill the frame. No visible text, frame or border.

f-117-stealth-fighter-service.description: A dark, faceted, angular jet with flat panels and a pointed nose sits on a concrete apron at night in front of an open hangar with warm lights, with desert hills and a dark sky behind. Some small marks are on the fuselage, and no people are visible. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.

b-2-stealth-bomber-first-flight.description: A large dark flying-wing aircraft with no tail and a smooth blended body, gear down, hangs against a stormy cloud sky over a dry desert with a dirt track and distant mountains. No people, no text, no frame; the painting fills the square edge to edge.

patriot-missiles-scuds.description: A dark night desert scene. A boxy, angled multi-canister missile launcher sits on a military truck, firing a bright fiery missile whose trail arcs up across a black sky. A second streak falls from the upper right, and a faint city skyline glows low on the horizon. Ground is rubble-strewn sand with a small box unit nearby. No people, no visible text beyond a faint painter's mark in the lower right corner.

predator-drone-first-hellfire.description: A high-winged, long-winged unmanned aircraft with a bulbous nose sensor and a propeller at the rear flies over a dark desert at dusk, firing a missile from under its wing that leaves a bright orange exhaust flame. Dark stormy sky above, rugged brown mountains below. No visible text, frame or people.

mother-of-all-bombs-combat.description: A large olive-green cylindrical bomb with a pointed nose and grid fins slides down a cradle out of the open rear ramp of a dark grey four-engined propeller cargo aircraft, with a small parachute deployed behind it. Warm light glows inside the fuselage. Below are dark, stormy clouds and bare mountain ridges. Painterly oil style, edge to edge, no visible text.
